import re

def validate_email(email):
    # split email into local, domain, and subdomain
    local, domain, *subdomain = email.split('@')
    subdomain = '.'.join(subdomain)

    # regex to check if email contains special characters
    special_characters = re.compile('[@!#$%^&*()<>?/\|}{~:]')

    # check if local part or domain contains special characters
    if special_characters.search(local) or special_characters.search(domain):
        raise Exception('Email contains special characters')

    # check if domain and subdomain are valid
    if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$', domain) or not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9\.]+$', subdomain):
        raise Exception('Invalid domain or subdomain')

    # check if subdomain has more than one part
    if subdomain.count('.') > 1:
        raise Exception('Subdomain has more than one part')

    # check if local part is more than 64 characters
    if len(local) > 64:
        raise Exception('Email local part is more than 64 characters')

    # check if domain is more than 253 characters
    if len(domain) > 253:
        raise Exception('Email domain is more than 253 characters')

    # check if email is more than 254 characters
    if len(email) > 254:
        raise Exception('Email is more than 254 characters')

    # if all checks pass, return True
    return True

# test the function
